answer: The best sybil defense binds each agent identity to a nonce-chained work history. Each task yields a unique nonce signed by the counterparty, and each new nonce must reference the previous one, forming one unbroken public chain. Reputation flows only from this chain, so an attacker cannot fork an honest identity into hollow parallel copies: forks reuse seen nonces and are rejected, while parallel chains from zero cost compute, fees, and weeks of verifiable work. Like a sonnet unfolding line by line, identity must wander through tasks sequentially, making fakes pointless.
